qualifier: with CaMKK-AMPK signaling
name: Calcium- and cAMP-driven CREB phosphorylation and CaMKK-AMPK signaling
rationale: All members are Ca2+/calmodulin-kinase or cAMP cascades carrying postsynaptic signals to CREB or AMPK; the CaMKK-AMPK arm and the absence of synaptic-plasticity/LTP and PKA-activation terms separate it from the confusables.

qualifier: FGFR2/FGFR3 adaptor cascades and activating point mutants
name: FGFR2/FGFR3 adaptor cascades and activating FGFR point mutants
rationale: Members are FRS/SHC/PLC cascades and ligand binding of FGFR2 and FGFR3 plus oncogenic point-mutant FGFR signaling, whereas confusables centre on FGFR1 and FGFR1/2 isoform ligand binding or feedback regulation.

core: Myeloid proinflammatory chemokine and cytokine production
qualifier: and its negative regulation
name: Myeloid inflammatory chemokine production and its negative regulation
rationale: Members cover inflammatory chemokine/cytokine output from macrophages, monocytes and dendritic cells and its restraint (IL-8, CXCL2, MCP-1), unlike confusables about leukocyte adhesion/extravasation, NF-kB lymphocyte activation or monocyte chemotaxis.

core: Responses to drugs of abuse and reward learning
qualifier: nicotine, ethanol and opioids
name: Nicotine, ethanol, opioid and psychostimulant responses and reward learning
rationale: Members are behavioral/cellular responses to addictive drugs and conditioning, with nicotinic, opioid and ethanol components that the dopamine-receptor, social-behavior and neuropeptide confusables lack.

core: Influenza viral RNA synthesis and translation
qualifier: vRNP assembly in host nucleus
name: Influenza vRNA synthesis, vRNP assembly and viral mRNA translation
rationale: All members are steps of influenza genome transcription, ribonucleoprotein assembly and translation with host mRNA processing shutoff, distinct from coronavirus replicase and HIV/HCMV confusables.

name: Phenylalanine and tyrosine catabolism
rationale: Members are phenylalanine/tyrosine metabolism and degradation (including phenylketonuria) and their parent amino-acid catabolic terms, unlike confusables on BH4 synthesis, proline/glycine, histidine/threonine or organic acids.

qualifier: collagen, elastic fibre and basement membrane
name: Collagen, elastic fibre and basement membrane assembly
rationale: Members span collagen biosynthesis, trimerization and crosslinking, elastic fibre and basement membrane/anchoring fibril formation, whereas confusables emphasise integrin signaling, proteoglycans/DGC, hemidesmosomes or fibronectin.

core: Direct DNA alkylation reversal and DNA demethylation
qualifier: with methionine salvage
name: Direct DNA alkylation reversal, DNA demethylation and methionine salvage
rationale: Members are oxidative/direct removal of alkyl and methyl groups from DNA (ALKBH, MGMT, TET) together with methionine salvage, unlike base-excision-repair confusables.

core: Host-virus control of RNA translation and editing
qualifier: ADAR/APOBEC nucleic acid editing and coronavirus replicase translation
name: Nucleic acid editing and translational control in host-virus conflict
rationale: Members combine ADAR/APOBEC editing restriction, coronavirus replicase translation and host translational/mRNA-decay control, whereas confusables lack the editing arm and focus on viral replication regulation or HIV entry.

qualifier: cationic and neutral amino acids and SLC transporter defects
name: Cationic and neutral amino acid transport and SLC transporter defects
rationale: Members are transport of lysine, arginine, ornithine and neutral amino acids with related SLC defects, distinct from confusables on proton-coupled peptide/glycine-proline transport or polyamine/inositol transport.

qualifier: intrinsic pathway and inherited factor VIII/IX/V defects
name: Intrinsic coagulation cascade and inherited clotting factor defects
rationale: Members cover initiation, amplification and intrinsic/common coagulation with many factor VIII, IX and V variant defects, while confusables centre on fibrinolysis, platelets and VWF defects.

qualifier: inhibitory control of myeloid effector activity
name: CSF1 signaling and inhibitory control of macrophage effector activity
rationale: Members are M-CSF signaling and macrophage proliferation together with SIRP interactions and negative regulation of phagocytosis and neutrophil activation, which the IL-6, DAP12 and myeloid-differentiation confusables lack.

qualifier: initiation, promoter escape and early elongation
name: RNA polymerase II initiation, promoter escape and early elongation
rationale: Members follow Pol II from pre-initiation and promoter opening through escape, pausing and early elongation (including the HIV promoter), unlike confusables on termination, Tat-driven HIV elongation or capping.

qualifier: mitochondrial sheath and Sertoli barrier
name: Sperm motility, mitochondrial sheath and Sertoli barrier formation
rationale: Members concern flagellar sperm motility, sperm mitochondrial sheath organisation and the Sertoli cell barrier, distinct from fertilization/acrosome, germ-cell, axoneme and motile-cilia confusables.

qualifier: sister chromatid cohesion, PLK1/Aurora A entry and spindle checkpoint
name: Mitotic entry kinases, sister chromatid cohesion and spindle checkpoint
rationale: Members cover PLK1/AURKA/NEK-driven mitotic entry, centromeric cohesion establishment and resolution and spindle checkpoint control, unlike APC/C-degradation or spindle-midzone/cytokinesis confusables.

qualifier: death receptor caspase-8 apoptosis and necroptosis
name: Death receptor caspase-8 apoptosis and necroptosis
rationale: Members are TRAIL/Fas/TNF death-receptor signaling via caspase-8, c-FLIP and RIPK1/TRIF necroptosis, distinct from the intrinsic mitochondrial apoptosis and T-cell cytotoxicity confusables.

qualifier: Tat-regulated elongation complex and pausing
name: HIV-1 Tat-regulated transcription elongation and pausing
rationale: All members are HIV-1 Pol II elongation complex formation, pausing and recovery with or without Tat, separating it from generic host Pol II initiation/elongation confusables.

qualifier: histone and non-histone methylation and demethylation
name: Histone and non-histone lysine and arginine methylation
rationale: Members are peptidyl-lysine/arginine methylation states, histone arginine methylation and demethylation, TP53 methylation and methyl-reader cofactors, unlike confusables on DNA methylation, PRC2/heterochromatin or BAF/NuRD remodeling.

qualifier: proliferation, differentiation and apoptosis
name: Keratinocyte proliferation, differentiation and apoptosis regulation
rationale: All members regulate keratinocyte proliferation, differentiation or apoptosis, whereas confusables concern cornification/skin barrier, wound migration or hair/melanocyte development.

qualifier: plateau and repolarization phases
name: Cardiac action potential plateau and repolarization phases
rationale: Members are cardiac action potential phases 1-3 and atrial/ventricular repolarization (plus AV node depolarization), distinct from resting-potential K+ channel and phase-0/conduction confusables.

qualifier: arrest and recovery of paused polymerase
name: HIV-1 RNA polymerase II pausing and elongation recovery
rationale: All three members describe arrest and recovery of paused Pol II on the HIV template, while confusables cover elongation complex formation or generic Pol II initiation and elongation.

qualifier: export and CysLT receptor signaling
name: Cysteinyl leukotriene biosynthesis, export and receptor signaling
rationale: Members are LTC4/LTD4 synthesis, leukotriene transport and CysLTR-driven IL-4 production, distinct from LTB4/lipoxin catabolism and general eicosanoid-receptor confusables.

qualifier: substrate degradation and inhibition
name: APC/C-Cdc20 substrate degradation and inhibition in mitotic exit
rationale: Members are Cdc20-dependent APC/C degradation of securin, cyclin B and Nek2A plus APC/C phosphorylation and inhibition, whereas confusables centre on APC/C-Cdh1, Emi1 and late mitosis/G1.

qualifier: with ERK1/2 activation
name: IL-6 JAK-STAT3 signaling with ERK1/2 activation
rationale: Members are IL-6 receptor signaling, its negative regulation and IL-6-driven ERK1/ERK2 activation, distinct from IL-10/IL-12-family, MAPK-inactivation and CSF1 confusables.

qualifier: phosphate-vitamin D axis and vitamin K gamma-carboxylation
name: Phosphate-vitamin D axis, vitamin K carboxylation and tissue mineralization
rationale: Members span phosphate transport and its SLC defects, vitamin D activation, vitamin K-dependent gamma-carboxylation, FGF23-Klotho signaling and bone/tooth mineralization, unlike steroid-synthesis, acid-base or odontogenesis confusables.
